ja200:1.1: sarīradabyaṁ vuḍḍhabyaṁ → sarīradavyaṁ vaddhavyaṁ (bj) | vaddhavyaṁ → vuḍḍhakhyaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | vuḍḍhabyaṁ → vaddhabyaṁ (cck: sī. pī.)
ja200:1.4: vanimhase → vaṇimbhase (bj); vaṇimhaseti (pts) | kaṁ nu → kinnu (sya-all) | kaṁ → kinnu (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | vanimhase → vaṇimhase (cck: sī. pī.)
ja200:2.2: vuḍḍhabyassa → vaddhavyassa (bj, pts) | vaddhavyassa → vuḍḍhabhyassa (bj: machasaṁ, syā)
